paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.04% on average, with FTSE 100 strongest (+2.85%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-5.38%). Brent crude changed +1.34% to 106.12. Gold changed -0.37% to 4,200.6001. Bitcoin changed -1.85% to 82,130.3594. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.089%, a relative move of -2.71%. Among the firms tracked, US Oil Fund (ETF) (+6.59%) and EQT (+6.02%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Credit Suisse bankers denied bonuses stripped after UBS takeover (FT World).
